title: Evidence store credential grant
description: Input file for the operator CLI's credential issue command. The CLI sends the grant to `POST /v1/operator/credentials` and writes the returned secret, once, to `secret_file`, which it creates with owner-only permissions (mode 0600 on Unix, an owner-only ACL on Windows) and refuses to overwrite. The secret never goes to stdout, argv, logs, or the repository. An empty `repository_ids` or `roles` list grants nothing: the credential is denied every request.

repository_ids.description: Stable numeric GitHub repository IDs. Empty denies all.

roles.description: Roles granted on every listed repository. Empty denies all. `operator` is never grantable here.

expires_in_days.description: Lifetime; missing means 90. Rotate at day 60.

replaces.description: Credential being rotated; it then expires within 7 days.

secret_file.description: Native local path the CLI creates for the token. Must not exist.
